# API Reference {.doc .doc-index}

## Core Types

Fundamental types for coordinates, units, domains, and cross-section timestamps.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Coordinate](Coordinate.qmd#timetoalign.Coordinate) | A position on a timeline, defined by a value and unit. |
| [CoordinateField](CoordinateField.qmd#timetoalign.CoordinateField) | Semantic field for coordinate fields. |
| [Coord](Coord.qmd#timetoalign.Coord) |  |
| [CoordinateSpec](CoordinateSpec.qmd#timetoalign.CoordinateSpec) |  |
| [CoordinateValue](CoordinateValue.qmd#timetoalign.CoordinateValue) |  |
| [IdCoordinate](IdCoordinate.qmd#timetoalign.IdCoordinate) | A ``Coordinate`` that carries the ID of the timeline it belongs to. |
| [Interval](Interval.qmd#timetoalign.Interval) | A non-decreasing interval between two plain coordinates. |
| [IntervalField](IntervalField.qmd#timetoalign.IntervalField) | Semantic field storing intervals with shared axis metadata. |
| [OptionalCoordinate](OptionalCoordinate.qmd#timetoalign.OptionalCoordinate) |  |
| [ResolvedCoordinate](ResolvedCoordinate.qmd#timetoalign.ResolvedCoordinate) | Decomposed form of a CoordinateSpec input. |
| [resolve_coordinate_spec](resolve_coordinate_spec.qmd#timetoalign.resolve_coordinate_spec) | Decompose a coordinate specification without converting its unit. |
| [Domain](Domain.qmd#timetoalign.Domain) | The temporal domain of a timeline. |
| [TimeUnit](TimeUnit.qmd#timetoalign.TimeUnit) | Units of measurement for coordinates. |
| [NumberType](NumberType.qmd#timetoalign.NumberType) | The numeric type used for coordinate values. |
| [EventType](EventType.qmd#timetoalign.EventType) | Whether an event is an instant or interval. |
| [ColumnNaming](ColumnNaming.qmd#timetoalign.ColumnNaming) | How to name columns in timestamp DataFrames. |
| [ColumnRole](ColumnRole.qmd#timetoalign.ColumnRole) | Semantic role of a column in the table. |
| [ScopedId](ScopedId.qmd#timetoalign.ScopedId) | An identifier with a scope prefix and local part. |
| [IdGenerator](IdGenerator.qmd#timetoalign.IdGenerator) | Generates unique IDs within a given scope. |
| [TimeStamp](TimeStamp.qmd#timetoalign.TimeStamp) | A synchronized instant across a timeline hierarchy. |
| [TimeIntervalStamp](TimeIntervalStamp.qmd#timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp) | A synchronized collection of canonical typed timeline intervals. |

## Timelines

Timeline classes for all six domain/modality combinations.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Timeline](Timeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.Timeline) | A positive coordinate axis with events and nested child timelines. |
| [ContinuousLogicalTimeline](ContinuousLogicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.ContinuousLogicalTimeline) | A logical timeline with continuous coordinates. |
| [DiscreteLogicalTimeline](DiscreteLogicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.DiscreteLogicalTimeline) | A logical timeline with discrete (integer) coordinates. |
| [ContinuousPhysicalTimeline](ContinuousPhysicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.ContinuousPhysicalTimeline) | A physical timeline with continuous coordinates. |
| [DiscretePhysicalTimeline](DiscretePhysicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.DiscretePhysicalTimeline) | A physical timeline with discrete (integer) coordinates. |
| [ContinuousGraphicalTimeline](ContinuousGraphicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.ContinuousGraphicalTimeline) | A graphical timeline with continuous coordinates. |
| [DiscreteGraphicalTimeline](DiscreteGraphicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.DiscreteGraphicalTimeline) | A graphical timeline with discrete (integer) coordinates. |
| [LogicalTimeline](LogicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.LogicalTimeline) | A timeline representing logical/musical time. |
| [PhysicalTimeline](PhysicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.PhysicalTimeline) | A timeline representing physical/acoustic time. |
| [GraphicalTimeline](GraphicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.GraphicalTimeline) | A timeline representing graphical/spatial coordinates. |
| [SegmentLine](SegmentLine.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.SegmentLine) | A timeline whose cached parameterized classes inherit the segment API. |
| [UnknownLengthError](UnknownLengthError.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.UnknownLengthError) | An operation needs the end of a timeline whose length is unknown. |

## Beat Grids

Tempo segments that generate a labelled lattice of beats on a seconds axis.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [BeatGrid](BeatGrid.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.BeatGrid) | A sequence of tempo segments and the beats they generate. |
| [BeatGridSegment](BeatGridSegment.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.BeatGridSegment) | One tempo segment of a beat grid: an anchor beat and how it repeats. |
| [GridBeat](GridBeat.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.GridBeat) | One beat of a grid, labelled in both numbering schemes. |
| [BeatPolicy](BeatPolicy.qmd#timetoalign.core.BeatPolicy) | How a bar is counted in beats: a grouping cycle over one division. |
| [policy_for_metro](policy_for_metro.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.policy_for_metro) | Read a grid's meter string as one beat per counted note value. |

## Flow Control

Score flow-graph traversal, atomic-section labelling, and structural diagnostics.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Flow](Flow.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.Flow) | A computed flow (sequence of measure visitations). |
| [FlowMap](FlowMap.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.FlowMap) | Coordinate transformation map for flow control. |
| [FlowMapSection](FlowMapSection.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.FlowMapSection) | A section mapping in a FlowMap. |
| [FlowControllerBase](FlowControllerBase.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.FlowControllerBase) | Abstract base class for computing flow control transformations. |
| [ScoreFlowController](ScoreFlowController.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.ScoreFlowController) | Score flow controller specialized for score data (MeasureData). |
| [SegmentNameGenerator](SegmentNameGenerator.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.SegmentNameGenerator) | Assign display labels to a run of atomic sections. |
| [AtomicSection](AtomicSection.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.AtomicSection) | Smallest indivisible traversal unit (similar to partitura's segment model). |
| [PlaythroughSection](PlaythroughSection.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.PlaythroughSection) | A contiguous group of atomic sections in a specific traversal. |
| [FlowDiagnostic](FlowDiagnostic.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.FlowDiagnostic) | A structural-invariant violation found in an atomic flow graph. |
| [load_valid_flows](load_valid_flows.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.load_valid_flows) | Load all valid flows from a .flow.csv file, grouped by flow_mode. |
| [create_unfolded_timeline](create_unfolded_timeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.create_unfolded_timeline) | Create an unfolded timeline from a folded source via structural slicing. |

## Conversion Maps

Functions for transforming coordinates between units.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [ConversionMap](ConversionMap.qmd#timetoalign.ConversionMap) | Abstract base class for coordinate conversion maps. |
| [ScalarMap](ScalarMap.qmd#timetoalign.ScalarMap) | Pure scaling transformation: y = scalar * x. |
| [LinearMap](LinearMap.qmd#timetoalign.LinearMap) | Affine transformation: y = scalar * x + offset. |
| [ShiftMap](ShiftMap.qmd#timetoalign.ShiftMap) | Pure offset transformation: y = x + offset. |
| [TableMap](TableMap.qmd#timetoalign.TableMap) | Lookup table with interpolation between anchor points. |
| [ChainMap](ChainMap.qmd#timetoalign.ChainMap) | Composition of multiple maps: f(g(h(x))). |
| [ConstantMap](ConstantMap.qmd#timetoalign.ConstantMap) | A ConversionMap that returns a constant value for any input. |
| [IntervalToConstantMap](IntervalToConstantMap.qmd#timetoalign.IntervalToConstantMap) | Interval-to-constant map: each interval [x_i, x_{i+1}) maps to value_i. |
| [InterpolationMap](InterpolationMap.qmd#timetoalign.InterpolationMap) | Bidirectional coordinate mapping using numpy.interp. |
| [PiecewiseMap](PiecewiseMap.qmd#timetoalign.PiecewiseMap) | Map defined by different maps on different intervals. |
| [SecondsToSamples](SecondsToSamples.qmd#timetoalign.SecondsToSamples) | Convert seconds to audio samples by multiplying by sample rate. |
| [QuartersToFloatingMeasures](QuartersToFloatingMeasures.qmd#timetoalign.QuartersToFloatingMeasures) | Map quarters to floating measures. |
| [QuartersToMeasureNumber](QuartersToMeasureNumber.qmd#timetoalign.QuartersToMeasureNumber) | Map quarters to measure number labels (no interpolation). |

## Alignment

Classes for connecting and aligning timelines.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [TimelineGroup](TimelineGroup.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.TimelineGroup) | Container for commensurable timelines. |
| [AlignmentBundle](AlignmentBundle.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.AlignmentBundle) | The primary entry point for all alignment workflows. |
| [SupportPolicy](SupportPolicy.qmd#timetoalign.core.SupportPolicy) | How to treat a transferred coordinate that falls outside alignment support. |
| [AlignmentAnchor](AlignmentAnchor.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.AlignmentAnchor) | A coordinate pair associating one coordinate on timeline A with one |
| [MatchClaim](MatchClaim.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim) | A claim that two events or coordinates on different timelines correspond. |
| [ClaimType](ClaimType.qmd#timetoalign.core.ClaimType) | The semantic kind of a MatchClaim, derived from its structure. |
| [MatchClaimField](MatchClaimField.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaimField) | A ``SemanticField[MatchClaim]`` columnar store for pairwise claims. |
| [MatchMetadata](MatchMetadata.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.MatchMetadata) | Provenance information for a match claim. |
| [Agent](Agent.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.Agent) | The author of a match claim — a human annotator or a software aligner. |
| [MatchGraph](MatchGraph.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.MatchGraph) | A graph of MatchClaims connecting events across timelines/groups. |
| [MatchStamp](MatchStamp.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.MatchStamp) | A synchronized timestamp across multiple timelines. |
| [MatchLine](MatchLine.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.MatchLine) | Ordered sequence of MatchStamps for a source timeline. |
| [WarpMap](WarpMap.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.WarpMap) | Bidirectional coordinate warping derived from alignment data. |
| [ClaimFilter](ClaimFilter.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.ClaimFilter) | Reusable filter for querying MatchClaims and related objects. |
| [MatchFileContext](MatchFileContext.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.MatchFileContext) | Supplementary data required for ``.match`` file export. |
| [NoteRecord](NoteRecord.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.NoteRecord) | Performance note record for ``.match`` format export. |
| [SnoteRecord](SnoteRecord.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.SnoteRecord) | Score note record for ``.match`` format export. |
| [TimelineIdGenerator](TimelineIdGenerator.qmd#timetoalign.TimelineIdGenerator) | Generates systematic timeline IDs based on type. |

## Loaders

Data ingestion from various file formats.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Loader](Loader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.Loader) | Shared lifecycle for all loader families. |
| [EventData](EventData.qmd#timetoalign.EventData) | PyArrow-based storage for timeline events. |
| [EventStore](EventStore.qmd#timetoalign.EventStore) | Abstract base class for collections of EventData. |
| [SingleStore](SingleStore.qmd#timetoalign.SingleStore) | Store wrapper for a single EventData. |
| [DictStore](DictStore.qmd#timetoalign.DictStore) | Generic EventStore with arbitrary named EventData tables. |
| [EventLoader](EventLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.EventLoader) | Abstract base class for event-producing loaders. |
| [AudioLoader](AudioLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.AudioLoader) | Load audio file metadata for creating physical timelines. |
| [AudioInfo](AudioInfo.qmd#timetoalign.loader.AudioInfo) | Metadata for an audio file. |
| [RepoVizzLoader](RepoVizzLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.RepoVizzLoader) | Load RepoVizz XML manifests or single CSV files for creating physical timelines. |
| [RepoVizzInfo](RepoVizzInfo.qmd#timetoalign.loader.RepoVizzInfo) | Parsed metadata from a RepoVizz CSV file (legacy mode). |
| [EepNotesLoader](EepNotesLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.EepNotesLoader) | Loader for EEP ``.notes`` alignment files. |
| [CsvLoader](CsvLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.tabular.CsvLoader) | Loader for CSV (comma-separated values) files. |
| [TsvLoader](TsvLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.tabular.TsvLoader) | Loader for TSV (tab-separated values) files. |
| [LabLoader](LabLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.tabular.LabLoader) | Loader for Audacity/Praat label files (.lab, .txt). |
| [SoloLoader](SoloLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.tabular.SoloLoader) | Loader for ``.solo`` performance-precision specimen files. |
| [TabularLoader](TabularLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.tabular.TabularLoader) | Vectorized base class for loading tabular data with column/field specs. |
| [JsonLoader](JsonLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.format.JsonLoader) | Configurable JSON normaliser producing flat ``pa.Table`` objects. |
| [XmlLoader](XmlLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.format.XmlLoader) | Configurable XML normaliser producing flat ``pa.Table`` objects. |
| [Music21Loader](Music21Loader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.score.Music21Loader) | Load symbolic scores using music21. |
| [PartituraLoader](PartituraLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.score.PartituraLoader) | Load symbolic scores using partitura. |
| [Ms3Loader](Ms3Loader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.score.Ms3Loader) | Load symbolic scores from DCML-style TSV files. |
| [MeasureMapLoader](MeasureMapLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.score.MeasureMapLoader) | Load MeasureMap JSON files into ScoreStore. |
| [MidiLoader](MidiLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.midi.MidiLoader) | Abstract base class for MIDI loaders. |
| [PerformanceMidiLoader](PerformanceMidiLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.midi.performance.PerformanceMidiLoader) | Load performance MIDI files using mido. |
| [ScoreMidiLoader](ScoreMidiLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.midi.score.ScoreMidiLoader) | Load score MIDI files using partitura or a mido fast path. |
| [GraphicalLoader](GraphicalLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.graphical.GraphicalLoader) | Factory for building GraphicalStore objects. |
| [IIIFManifestLoader](IIIFManifestLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.graphical.IIIFManifestLoader) | Load image metadata from IIIF Presentation API manifests. |
| [ATONLoader](ATONLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.graphical.aton.ATONLoader) | Load ATON format files (piano roll analysis data). |
| [MatchfileLoader](MatchfileLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.alignment.matchfile.MatchfileLoader) | Load Vienna Match (.match) alignment files via partitura. |
| [TiliaJsonLoader](TiliaJsonLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.alignment.tilia.TiliaJsonLoader) | Loader for TiLiA JSON annotation exports. |
| [TiliaDictStore](TiliaDictStore.qmd#timetoalign.loader.alignment.tilia.TiliaDictStore) | ``DictStore`` subclass with convenience properties for TiLiA timeline types. |
| [PerformancePrecisionLoader](PerformancePrecisionLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.alignment.performance_precision.PerformancePrecisionLoader) | Load a Performance Precision specimen directory as an AlignmentBundle. |
| [ParangonadaLoader](ParangonadaLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.alignment.parangonada.ParangonadaLoader) | Load a parangonada CSV export as one multimodal AlignmentBundle. |
| [MpmLoader](MpmLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader) | Load an MPM-Toolbox MSM+MPM+MPR triple as one multimodal AlignmentBundle. |
| [ListenHereLoader](ListenHereLoader.qmd#timetoalign.loader.alignment.listen_here.ListenHereLoader) | Load a Listen Here! alignment JSON file as one AlignmentBundle. |
